svg.title: Botanical Syntax Detonation
svg.desc: A branching grammar turns through 257.5 degrees with angle jitter 72, far beyond the usual 90-degree and 20-degree maxima. Near-preserved branch lengths and large length jitter turn botanical recursion into an explosive, deeply tangled syntax. Native toolbar flow: nested path echoes → doubled branch strata.
